rows.why: S1 tests isDigestDue: the digest is due on Monday in the organisation's time zone. Item 12 asks whether buildDigest checks the weekday, which is a different question. No item asks how 'Monday' is decided in the local zone.
No item asks how daylight saving changes affect the Monday check.

Items 1, 7 and 8 all touch S3. Item 7 is the one the scenario settles outright: it states that a task with no submissions has furthest gate 0, and the pick reports 0. Item 8 is not really settled, because with gates 1 and 2 both 'highest' and 'latest' give 2. Item 1 (merged tasks not listed) also agrees.
S4 expects age to be whole 24-hour periods rounded down (9d23h gives 9, exactly 10d gives 10), which is the pick.

The core of S5 is the 14-day threshold: 'stalled when 14 days or more'. The pick uses >=. Items 5 and 6 (measure from postedAt with no submissions, from the latest submission otherwise) also agree with the scenario's other lines.
S6 expects stalled tasks first, then older tasks first, then by id, which matches the pick.
S7 expects '1 open task' in the singular. The pick always writes 'tasks', even for 1.

S8 settles that nothing open means no digest, not an empty one. Item 11 asks whether the time zone is validated in that case, which is a different question. No item asks whether an empty digest is returned or none at all.
S9 only says an unknown zone fails with an error that names it. Item 11 asks whether validation also runs when nothing is open, and S9 doesn't cover that case, so it doesn't settle item 11.
